text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not alone in today's race!
Right beside me is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios, all set!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪
Vroooom, vroom-vroooom☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Takarazuka Kinen, let's gooo★
Pal-chin, today's the day we turn up the hype!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, McQueen is here. Ryan is here.
Grandmother is coming to watch too.
Just like the Spring Tenno Sho. But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Today, the "me" here is different!
I have something I can truly be proud of!
choice_data_list: ...It seems Grandmother won't be able to come.
...It seems Grandmother won't be able to come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you can't come?
For real?

I reveal a special piece of information by way of cheering her on:
They apparently can't make it because of an important meeting in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother isn't here...! Which means
no matter how wild I get—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A chance to take flight!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy☆ Ayy-ayy-ayyyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer, whoooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios, 'sup☆
Mejiro Palmer dashed out into the paddock with an energy on a whole different level compared to the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Takarazuka Kinen is a carnivaaal!
Me and my bestie are runnin' the show today!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy☆ Spin it♪ Sound it♪
Pump it, PUMP. IT. UUUUP!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"We're the absolute strongest, most insane duo!
Nobody can keep up with us! ☆
You can't just slam the brakes on these vibes! ★"

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyyyyyy☆
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa, McQueen.
Palmer's vibe is just~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not quite sure what happened,
but she seems to have cast all shame aside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a total lack of restraint...
And yet, I find myself liking her current self much better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I'm right here.
Standing tall.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Win or lose—I get to run as myself.
Allllright!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Helios!?
Ain't that Helios?
In addition to Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, an unexpected rival was also running in this race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! What a coincidence.
Never thought I'd run into you at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real? Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I feel like
your name was carved onto the party list...

Bamboo Memory. A hot-blooded Disciplinary Committee head
who's supposed to be better suited for sprint and mile races, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why'd you enter? Isn't the distance
kinda brutal? Won't you gas out halfway through?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, but I've got fans who hype me up like that! Saying stuff like, "My dream is Bamboo!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you put it like that,
then I've got no choice but to run.
After all, the Takarazuka Kinen is the race where dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I see... Gotcha. The fan's dream is Bambi-pi, huh.
Then my dream is—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She's my bestie over there!
Today, we're definitely gonna bust our guts laughing together
and sprint all the way through to the very end!
